largestGap.statement: A supported public complete-mode compatibility composition can invoke the same non-idempotent synthetic body twice for one durable pending dispatch and still return COMPLETED.

findings.title: Complete-mode compatibility tools can replay an unresolved non-idempotent dispatch without a journal

sourceAnchors.reason: Only capabilities require an effect journal; tools composition returns the unjournaled registry when the journal is absent.
Recovery checks the special settlement-failed error and successful settled steps, but RUNNING plus no TOOL_RESULT falls through.
Restores the pending tool decision for dispatch without proof of prior settlement.
Treats the pending step as already counted, checkpoints it again and re-enters the normal tool pipeline.

findings.preconditions: Opt-in complete mode; public tools compatibility port; no effectJournal; non-idempotent synthetic WRITE tool; a durable pending decision and RUNNING step captured after the first body began, before completion/settlement.
findings.repro: recovery.test.ts: one shared synthetic counter; capture the actual pre-completion checkpoint/steps; abort old runtime for cleanup; reconstruct only captured durable state through real memory-store CAS/recordStep; construct a fresh public harness; run the same execution.
findings.expected: Reject unsafe composition or hand off unresolved prior tool execution before another body. A missing settlement/journal must not authorize replay.
